# Soham Vyas — IIT Jodhpur | AI & Systems Engineer

> Soham Vyas (GitHub: @vyassoham) is a BS (Hons) Data Science & Applied AI student at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Jodhpur, based in Rajasthan, India. He is an upstream open-source contributor to SymPy (targeting GSoC 2027) and builds production Python, FastAPI, Redis, and machine learning systems.

## Featured Open Source & Projects
- [SymPy Kronecker Trace Optimization](https://www.soham.lol/blog/sympy-kronecker-trace/): Deep dive on eliminating O(n^3) matrix expansion via O(1) scalar trace decomposition in SymPy PR #31011.
- [AI Rate Limiter Shield](https://github.com/vyassoham/ai-rate-limiter-shield): FastAPI and Redis sliding-window API security shield with atomic Lua scripts and Isolation Forest anomaly detection.
- [SocialLogger](https://github.com/vyassoham/SocialLogger): Multi-platform social media management SaaS built with Python and FastAPI.
- [MediPro](https://github.com/vyassoham/MediPro): Offline desktop medical intelligence suite with SQLite and Tesseract OCR.
